lines.text: Believers must not continue in sin so grace increases, because they died to sin.
Those baptized into Christ Jesus were buried with Him into death, so we may walk by the Spirit.
Our old self was crucified with Christ so that we would no longer be slaves to sin.
Raised from the dead, Christ cannot die again; He died to sin seven times, but lives to God.
Believers must count themselves dead to sin and alive to God, because sin will not master them under grace.
